FUNCTION G40_07_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_07_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_07_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 118) THEN
    G40_07_PROVIDER = 118
  END IF
  G40_07_PROVIDER = G40_07_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION

END FUNCTION
